summary: Insufficiently stamped power of attorney admitted in evidence; Trial Court recalled admission; High Court reversed citing section 35 of Karnataka Stamp Act; issue: whether court can revisit document admission via inherent powers under section 151 CPC; Supreme Court held court may recall admission despite section 35, using inherent powers to prevent abuse of process; stamp defect remedy not confined to section 58 revision.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 47 Rule 1
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court order restored requiring payment of deficit stamp duty and penalty.
